summary: Tested the new '📣 Notify customer of change' toggle end-to-end (backend + frontend). Wrote /app/backend/tests/test_booking_notify_customer.py (10 tests, all passing) covering silent path, notify path with email, notify path with phone, no-contact case, contact-only edit still notifying, and the booking_updated_email template (price-block shown only when prices differ, hidden otherwise, reason block optional, pay-link + branding present). Ran Playwright against the preview URL: admin login → Pending Payments → Edit → verified toggle default OFF, silent helper text, lime-highlight + email/SMS helper text when checked, form re-initialises on reopen, and two save flows produce the expected differing toasts ('Booking updated' vs 'Booking updated — customer notified'). Seeded bookings and the shared booking 0e82e85a…4028f8cab2bd were reset/cleaned after tests.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py notification block silently swallows all send_email/send_sms failures via bare except and still returns notify_result=False — consider surfacing the error reason (e.g. notify_result.email_error) so admins know why the customer wasn't reached. Currently the UI toasts 'customer notified' even when the underlying send returned status='error' — misleading.

The pay_link falls back to https://text2toss.com when neither PUBLIC_SITE_URL nor BACKEND_URL are configured; on staging/preview this could send a customer to the production site. Consider making the base URL a required config with a hard fail at startup.

field_labels dict silently ignores unknown keys added to booking_patch (e.g. future fields like 'notes'); safe today but easy to forget when extending — add a test or fall back to the raw key so nothing goes un-communicated.

AdminDashboard: repeated 'LoadScript has been reloaded unintentionally' warning from @react-google-maps/api — libraries prop is being recreated on each render. Not blocking, but should be hoisted to a module-level const for perf.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (toggle visibility, default OFF, helper text switch, lime highlight, both toast variants)

seed_data_creation: Created and deleted TEST_notify_b_* / TEST_notify_q_* rows per test via fixtures; created & deleted TEST_ui_b_076cbb70 + linked quote for the Playwright run; reset booking 0e82e85a-d70c-447c-85d9-4028f8cab2bd back to $180.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Notify toggle flow (backend + frontend) is fully green. Note: EMAIL_ENABLED=true and Twilio creds are set, so send_email/send_sms return status='sent' at API-acceptance level (Twilio may 400 on obviously-fake numbers like +1555… — use +14155552671 or similar plausible formats when testing SMS delivery). Silent path returns notify_result={sent_email:False,sent_sms:False}; notify path fires only when notify_customer=true AND (price_change OR booking_patch is non-empty).
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no defects found in this iteration.
